comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Small rural Alaska hydro electric utility combined with telephone and broadband; telecom mix and remote-community profile differ from ConEd's urban network.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Regulated water and wastewater utility; similar regulated model but different product from electricity, gas and steam delivery.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Rate-regulated integrated electric and natural gas utility delivering to residential, commercial and industrial customers, like ConEd.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Upstream gas producer with merchant power and carbon capture; commodity-price exposed, not a regulated delivery utility.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Mainly gas distribution and pipelines with a large propane business; smaller electric part and different mix from ConEd's electric-led utility.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Regulated water and wastewater utility in Arizona; different commodity and developer-driven growth.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Gas distribution utility plus wholesale energy marketing, storage and solar; no electric or steam delivery, and its mix differs.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Small single-territory gas distribution utility only; lacks ConEd's electric and steam delivery.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Unregulated retail propane and fuel oil distributor with HVAC services; not a regulated network utility.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Regulated electric utility holding company owning transmission and distribution networks, selling to residential, commercial and industrial customers like ConEd's electric business.
